title: Apricot Promenade
description: An F-major waltz opens with a falling ribbon, answered by a rising sixth. A five-bar refrain gives way to light displaced chords, then a more radiant high-register turn. The opening returns above a changed bass; two quiet steps end with an unexpectedly bright chord.
technical_note: Float the melody over detached bass-and-chord steps. Keep the offbeat dyads light, project the top of the central thirds and release the written pauses cleanly. The final chord returns to the opening pulse.

performance.note: Deliberate dance pulse, shaped phrases and terraced dynamics; no random timing.

composition_time_source: Recorded when the first score was saved.

audio_reverb.description: Subtle warm room; preserve the clarity of moving voices.
